title: Swimming in Murder
summary: The singer of a band is found electrocuted in a swimming pool, when a lighting stand falls into the water.
method: Ice was used to prop up the lighting stand, establishing an alibi for the killer, who was in the studio with everyone else. The ice melting left behind a beetle, which was a clue that ice was used in the trick.
motive: The victim was unwilling to sign a commercial deal, so the killer forged his signature and set the stage for the elaborate murder
notes:
